claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pirenperone is a 5-HT2A/2C antagonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated serotonin-receptor mechanism; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic or other nonspecific off-target effect rather than a defined cytotoxic class.
